description: In-domain retrieval benchmark for the who_guidelines collection. Each question is answerable from an indexed clinical guideline, and `expected_source` labels the document that must be retrieved. This makes precision@k, MRR, and hit rate diagnostic -- unlike the meddata QA corpus, whose rare-genetic-disease questions are not covered by WHO public-health guidelines at all, so scores there reflect corpus mismatch rather than retrieval quality.

queries.question: At what systolic blood pressure does WHO recommend starting antihypertensive treatment?
Which drug classes are first-line for hypertension?
When is single-pill combination therapy recommended for blood pressure control?
What fasting plasma glucose and A1C values are diagnostic for diabetes?
At what age should adults be screened for prediabetes and type 2 diabetes?
What is the cornerstone of maintenance therapy for persistent asthma?
How should a severe acute asthma exacerbation be managed?
